outcome: Create a deterministic local-only workflow for inventorying and validating tracked repository snapshots without modifying source repositories or publishing remotely.
definition_of_done: The workflow inventories local Git repositories without reading or storing source contents.
Approved repositories can be exported from tracked HEAD into an isolated staging directory.
Validation fails closed on unresolved approval, sensitive paths, secret-like content, large files, submodules, or Git LFS pointers.
Tests prove source repositories remain unchanged.

entries.rationale: PowerShell provides execution primitives but not the required repository approval, staging, and validation contract.
Git can export a tracked snapshot but does not enforce local state isolation or source-safety policy.

gap_evidence.gap: No existing local capability combines metadata-only inventory, explicit approval state, isolated tracked-HEAD export, and fail-closed validation.

lower_level_evaluations.rationale: Available commands provide individual primitives but no complete policy-enforcing workflow.
A small inspectable script can enforce the required local-only workflow without a skill, agent, or orchestration system.

capability_steamroll.rationale: The durable value is the repository-specific safety contract and evidence, not a complex implementation.
capability_steamroll.mitigation: Retire the script if GitHub or the local platform provides equivalent policy-enforced staging.

initiative_collision.rationale: Existing repository and automation features provide pieces of the workflow but not the required personal publishing boundary.
initiative_collision.mitigation: Keep the implementation narrow and reuse Git and PowerShell rather than creating a broader platform.

durable_owner.accountability: Own the source-safe publishing policy, deterministic staging implementation, and verification evidence.

verification_evidence.claim: The deterministic evaluator must return allow before implementation.
Fixture tests must prove source repositories remain unchanged.

boundaries.safety: No GitHub repository creation, push, deletion, force update, visibility change, or source-repository mutation is authorized in this implementation slice.
boundaries.privacy: Machine-specific inventory and staged source remain ignored local state; committed artifacts contain only source-safe policy and synthetic examples.
boundaries.human_review: Nick retains per-repository authority for ownership classification and any later private publication.
boundaries.rollback: Delete ignored staging state and stop using the script; source repositories are unchanged.

retirement_trigger: Retire when the publication need ends or a narrower trusted platform feature provides equivalent isolation and verification.
